description: This file contains test definitions for payload helpers related to interactive messages, including functions to check content presence, normalize interactive reply objects, and resolve text fallbacks.

methods.name: hasReplyChannelData
methods.description: Checks if the given object has non-empty reply channel data.

methods.name: hasReplyContent
methods.description: Determines if the reply content contains meaningful data, ignoring whitespace-only text and empty structures.

methods.name: hasReplyPayloadContent
methods.description: Checks if the reply payload content has relevant data, considering text, extra content, and channel data.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveReply
methods.description: Normalizes an interactive reply object to ensure consistent structure.

methods.name: resolveInteractiveTextFallback
methods.description: Generates a fallback text string from an interactive reply's blocks.
